title: Refusal-Direction Ablation: Robustness of the Abliteration Trace After Quantization

original_idea.body: Refusal-direction robustness after quantization (extends arXiv:2602.11495): extract refusal direction and detection probe at FP16/8-bit/4-bit, measure cosine similarity and probe AUROC degradation.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Whether safety signals survive the near-universal quantized deployment is a concrete, deployment-relevant blind spot.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Refusal-direction extraction at 3 precisions + cosine/AUROC; standard tooling, accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped cross-precision similarity + probe-degradation deliverable.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Quantized deployment is exactly the out-of-lab setting labs ignore; strong counterfactual value.

low_compute.reasoning: Quantized single-GPU forward passes; very cheap.

novelty.reasoning: Quantization effect on refusal-direction signals untested; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Quantization robustness of refusal-direction signal untested.
